name: Hyogo

flag.description: White waves across a light blue field, forming the kanji 兵 (hyō).
flag.symbolism: 兵 is the first character of Hyōgo, drawn as waves because the prefecture faces both the Sea of Japan and the Seto Inland Sea; blue stands for youth.

hook: Hyogo's flag is all waves: white stripes on blue that, looked at closely, form the kanji 兵 (hyō).
trivia: Himeji Castle, the "White Heron Castle", is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Japan Standard Time is set on the 135th meridian, which runs through Akashi in Hyōgo.
